subject: Resale & lead-registration — draft terms, clawback and HubSpot flow
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramirez <alex@cloudops.io>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Resale & lead-registration — draft terms, clawback and HubSpot flow

Hi Alex — great speaking last week. As promised attaching a working draft and a short lead-registration spreadsheet to make the handoff operational. High-level proposal (open to trade-offs):

- Commercial model: 20% rev-share on first 12 months ARR for deals CloudOps resells (net of discounts/credits); 10% ongoing thereafter for renewal years where CloudOps maintains a named customer relationship.
- Lead registration: 120-day registration window from first qualified touch in HubSpot; registration requires (a) HubSpot lead record with redwood:partner tag, (b) copy of discovery notes, (c) named AE handoff.
- Co-sell credit: if Redwood directly closes a lead you sourced and CloudOps helped drive the deal, we will provide a 10% co-sell uplift on top of the standard reseller commission for the first invoice period.
- Clawback: commissions are subject to a 90-day clawback for refunds/cancellations; clawback limited to 50% of paid commissions if customer churns within 90 days. Exceptions: self-sourced customers (entered directly into CloudOps CRM and not routed via our partner integration) are excluded.
- Exclusivity: none. We can discuss region-specific carve-outs but won't do global exclusives for reseller starter engagements.

Operational asks: please confirm CloudOps' HubSpot account ID and whether you can accept partner tags/events via our integration. Also confirm whether you prefer commissions paid monthly via ACH or quarterly invoice.

Attachments: redwood-resale-draft-v3.pdf (terms + sample SOW language), lead-registration-process.xlsx (fields and example flow).

If those high-level levers look reasonable I can route to legal for a tracked redline and send a DocuSign envelope for signatures.

Thanks — Camila

--
Camila Reyes

From: Alex Ramirez <alex@cloudops.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:05:31 -0700
Subject: Re: Resale & lead-registration — draft terms, clawback and HubSpot flow

Camila — thanks for the draft and clear bullets. A few immediate questions from our side:

1) Revenue split: 20% on year one is plausible, but we typically look for 25% for new ISV partners when we commit lead gen and demo resources on our end. Is there room to move to 22.5% for the first year with 12-month minimum guarantee?
2) Clawback: 90 days is reasonable, but the 50% cap is unusual for us; we typically ask for a full clawback on refunded invoices within 60 days. Can we reduce the window to 60 days and allow full clawback? Alternatively, extend the cap window to 180 days if we accept 90 days.
3) Lead registration: 120 days is generous. Can CloudOps register via a simple form + unique lead ID and have the HubSpot sync be confirmation? We want something automated — manual tags won't scale for our sales teams.
4) Cohort carve-out: we will ask for a non-exclusive regional protection for the Northeast territory for deals we actively pursue for 9 months.

I copied Maria (alliances at SaaSify) — she has run similar resale programs and can share an automation template. We can get Treasury to confirm payout timing (we prefer monthly ACH).

If you can take these back to legal that would be great — otherwise we can jump in a quick 30-min call.

Best,
Alex

--
Alex Ramirez
Head of Channel Sales | CloudOps LLC
alex@cloudops.io | +1 212-555-0103
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Resale & lead-registration — draft terms, clawback and HubSpot flow

Quick internal note / negotiating posture before we respond to Alex:

- Revenue: we should keep flexibility but can offer 22% first year if CloudOps commits to a 12-month minimum ticket size (e.g., $10k ARR minimum per transacted account) and we get reporting access for co-sell attribution. Avoid blanket 25% as that materially impacts CAC.
- Clawback: prefer 90-day window with capped clawback (50%) to limit large retroactive payouts. If they push for full 60-day clawback we can offer a two-tier: full clawback for refunds <=60 days, 50% cap between 61-90 days. That splits the difference.
- Lead registration automation: legal ops hates manual tags. Product should support HubSpot webhook acceptance of lead registration form (we can create a partner registration endpoint). Ask Product to scope a lightweight webhook-based confirmation flow.
- Exclusivity: decline global exclusives. Regional, timeboxed protections OK (e.g., 9 months NE protection but must include named territory list and performance SLA).
- Payments: monthly ACH OK but require a monthly activity report for reconciliation; otherwise default to quarterly invoice.

Attached: quick payout model in lead-registration-process.xlsx (tab: "payout-scenarios"). Once we have agreement in principle, legal will produce a tracked redline.

Karthik
Director, GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramirez <alex@cloudops.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Resale & lead-registration — draft terms, clawback and HubSpot flow

Alex — appreciate the quick feedback and the template offer from Maria. We can do the following counter that keeps momentum:

- Commercial: 22% rev-share year one (subject to $10k ARR minimum per account), 10% ongoing.
- Clawback: two-tier approach: full clawback within 60 days; 50% cap on commission clawback for churn in days 61–90.
- Lead registration: we will provide a lightweight partner registration webhook and a short form; registration will be confirmed automatically into HubSpot (webhook confirmation = registration accepted). We will send the API spec to CloudOps and a sample Zap/automation template for SaaSify to reuse.
- Regional protection: we can grant a 9-month timeboxed Northeast protection for named target accounts you list in the registration form; protection is contingent on a minimum of 3 active pursuits per quarter in that region.
- Payments: monthly ACH, but we require monthly reconciliation reports (automated CSV export from HubSpot).

Next steps: I'm going to route the attached draft to Legal with these bullets as our negotiating posture and send a DocuSign envelope with the updated clauses. Please review the redlined summary in the attached PDF and confirm HubSpot account ID so we can wire up the webhook test.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/SigningEnvelope.aspx?envelopeId=abc123
HubSpot account: please share your portal ID (numbers-only).

Thanks — Camila

Camila / team — this looks good and appreciated the pragmatic counter. We accept the 22% / two-tier clawback approach and the 9-month NE protection with the performance clause. Treasury confirmed monthly ACH and Maria will help with the HubSpot automation template.

Two operational asks before DocuSign:
- HubSpot portal ID: 9876543 (we will grant a CRM integration test user).
- Please add a short clause for "HubSpot lead remediation" — if a lead registration is rejected due to incomplete fields we have a 7-day cure period to resubmit before the registration is void.

I'll sign the DocuSign once your legal adds the remediation clause. Looking forward to getting the webhook test up next week.

Thanks — Alex
